topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Race of Curves

sections.title: Introduction: Defining the Challenge (1 minute)
lecture_lines: Brachistochrone means shortest time in Greek.
What path minimizes travel time between two points?
animations: Display points A and B in #00FF00 with bead [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bead.svg].
Draw straight line (#FFFF00) and curved path (#FF00FF) with wire [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wire.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite Concept: Conservation of Energy (1 minute)
lecture_lines: Potential energy converts to kinetic energy.
Increased speed early reduces total travel time.
animations: Show total energy formula E = K + U in #FFFFFF.
Animate Kinetic energy K transforming into Potential energy U in #00FFFF, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vehicle.svg].
Highlight speed gain with velocity vector in #FFA500 attached to [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vehicle.svg].

sections.title: The Mathematical Formulation (1.5 minutes)
lecture_lines: We express time as an integral.
Time depends on path length and velocity.
Calculus of variations finds the optimal curve.
animations: Display the integral form: T = integral ds/v in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Display ds = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) and v = sqrt(2gy) in #FF0000.
Show the combined functional J(y) in #FFFF00.
Label J(y) as the time functional in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: The Solution: The Cycloid (1 minute)
lecture_lines: The solution is a cycloid curve.
A rolling circle traces this optimal path.
It perfectly balances distance and velocity.
animations: Display cycloid equations x=r(t-sin t), y=r(1-cos t) in #00FFFF.
Animate a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg] rolling along a line tracing path in #FFA500.

sections.title: Conclusion & Real-world Application (0.5 minutes)
lecture_lines: Hawks dive using this optimal path.
Engineers apply it to design roller coasters.
animations: Fade in 'Nature utilizes the brachistochrone principle' in #FFFFFF.
Show an animated hawk diving in a curved arc in #00FF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hawk.svg].
Display 'Engineers design roller coasters with this curve' in #FFA500 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rollercoaster.svg].
